title: Admin Menus: Add Your Own Links to the Admin Navigation | Orchard Core
description:
The admin menu offers many pages, and your team opens only a few of them every day.

The Admin Menu module lets you build menus of your own: links to the pages your team needs, placeholders that group them, and nodes that list your content types and blogs. You choose which roles see each menu.

In this video:
• Menus and nodes: two ideas and four kinds of node
• The Admin Menus page: where your menus live
• Create a menu
• Add a link with the Link Admin Node
• Group links with the Placeholder Admin Node
• Links that list content: Content Types and Lists
• Control who sees a menu: permissions, roles and switches
• Reuse your menus on other sites
